actions.action: Move the plant to brighter light, easing it gradually into part-day sun
Check what the current soil mix looks like
Repot into a chunky, well-draining mix (peat substitute with coarse sand, bark and perlite)

verdict.reason: The comments mention better soil, more light and more water but contradict each other with an overwatering claim and never address root-binding, so diagnosis and advice are partial; the 'overwatered, let it go dry' comment could push the owner to underwater a plant that needed more water.
